listing.name: Ms. Pac-Man Maze Madness — MsPacManMazeMadnessRecomp (adumah)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The project reports ahead-of-time translation of the native boot, main 3D and secondary 2D programs, with steady 60 FPS in busy Linux mazes. Portcove has not confirmed a playthrough or Steam Deck compatibility. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PS1 USA SLUS01018 own disc.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Keep your own CUE and all seven BIN tracks in disc/. Follow the project’s build_emitters.sh, psxrecomp_cli generate and CMake psx-runtime instructions, then start launch-mspacman.sh. The Switch build belongs to the same implementation but is outside this desktop setup guide.

warnings: The project reports ahead-of-time translation of the native boot, main 3D and secondary 2D programs, with steady 60 FPS in busy Linux mazes. Portcove has not confirmed a playthrough or Steam Deck compatibility.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
